mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates dampen corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer spending and business investment, triggering a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and business investment, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1350 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which correlates with reduced overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1350, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a further increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
